key: AME: \PN?
en: AME: \PN?
ja: アメ: \PN?

key: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
en: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
ja: やっほー! ジムに着いたみたいね。

key: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
en: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
ja: この通信システムは大ホールに直接つながってるから、どこにいても、ジムに着いたらいつでもアドバイスをもらえるのよ!

key: Anyway...
en: Anyway...
ja: それはそうと……

key: Wait, you're at Corey's Gym?
en: Wait, you're at Corey's Gym?
ja: 待って、そこってコーリーのジム?

key: ...He's not even a Leader anymore.
en: ...He's not even a Leader anymore.
ja: ……彼、もうリーダーですらないのに。

key: What are you doing?
en: What are you doing?
ja: 何やってるの?

key: Well, I probably still have some notes around here from before, in case you are going to challenge him for some reason...
en: Well, I probably still have some notes around here from before, in case you are going to challenge him for some reason...
ja: まあ、何か理由があって彼に挑むつもりなら、前のメモがまだこの辺に残ってると思うけど……

key: Corey sometimes uses something called a Corrosive Mist Field.
en: Corey sometimes uses something called a Corrosive Mist Field.
ja: コーリーは時々、「腐食霧フィールド」っていうのを使うのよ。

key: This scary tactic will poison any active Pokémon that it can every single turn!
en: This scary tactic will poison any active Pokémon that it can every single turn!
ja: この怖い戦法は、毎ターン、場に出ているポケモンをできる限り毒状態にしていくの!

key: Although that may sound daunting, it has a glaring weakness.
en: Although that may sound daunting, it has a glaring weakness.
ja: 恐ろしく聞こえるかもしれないけど、はっきりした弱点があるわ。

key: Since the poison is tied to the mist, you can use the air against him!
en: Since the poison is tied to the mist, you can use the air against him!
ja: 毒は霧に結びついてるから、空気を利用して彼に対抗できるの!

key: The noxious gas is combustible, so Fire-type Pokémon can eat right through it.
en: The noxious gas is combustible, so Fire-type Pokémon can eat right through it.
ja: 有毒ガスは可燃性だから、ほのおタイプのポケモンなら一気に食い破れるわ。

key: Careful not to use too much fire though!
en: Careful not to use too much fire though!
ja: でも、火を使いすぎないように気をつけて!

key: Or, if you bring a Pokémon that can clear the air, all that's left to do is power through his team like normal.
en: Or, if you bring a Pokémon that can clear the air, all that's left to do is power through his team like normal.
ja: それか、空気を晴らせるポケモンを連れていけば、あとは普通に彼のパーティーを力押しするだけよ。

key: As long as you get some breathing room, you'll be just fine!
en: As long as you get some breathing room, you'll be just fine!
ja: 息をつける余裕さえあれば、大丈夫なはずよ!

key: Corey's Corrosive Field can be very damaging to some Pokémon, particularly anything vulnerable to the Poison-type.
en: Corey's Corrosive Field can be very damaging to some Pokémon, particularly anything vulnerable to the Poison-type.
ja: コーリーの腐食フィールドは、特にどくタイプに弱いポケモンにとって、かなりのダメージになり得るわ。

key: On top of that, it boosts the effects of almost everything to do with poison, and activates attacks like Venoshock and Venom Drench...
en: On top of that, it boosts the effects of almost everything to do with poison, and activates attacks like Venoshock and Venom Drench...
ja: それに加えて、毒に関するほとんどの効果を強化して、「ベノムショック」や「ベノムトラップ」みたいなわざも発動させるの……

key: But! That means he's got too many eggs in one basket!
en: But! That means he's got too many eggs in one basket!
ja: でも! それってつまり、ひとつのかごに卵を入れすぎてるってことよ!

key: If you've got Poison, or even Steel-types yourself, his options are very limited!
en: If you've got Poison, or even Steel-types yourself, his options are very limited!
ja: あなたがどくタイプ、あるいははがねタイプを連れていれば、彼の選択肢はすごく限られるわ!

key: Save your offensive Pokémon to pick off things that can break through your anti-Poison defense.
en: Save your offensive Pokémon to pick off things that can break through your anti-Poison defense.
ja: あなたの毒対策を崩せそうな相手を仕留めるために、攻撃的なポケモンは温存しておいて。

key: Then all you need to do is set up and take him down!
en: Then all you need to do is set up and take him down!
ja: あとは、態勢を整えて彼を倒すだけよ!

key: Good luck with... whatever you're doing.
en: Good luck with... whatever you're doing.
ja: 何をしてるのか知らないけど……頑張ってね。

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: 大ホールの方、誰も出ないみたいね……

key: CHIEF: The situation has taken a turn for the worse!
en: CHIEF: The situation has taken a turn for the worse!
ja: 署長: 状況は悪化の一途だ!

key: We followed Corey in here, but he vanished!
en: We followed Corey in here, but he vanished!
ja: コーリーを追ってここまで来たが、消えてしまった!

key: Then those glowing reactors spewed out some kind of gas and my men completely lost it.
en: Then those glowing reactors spewed out some kind of gas and my men completely lost it.
ja: それから、あの光る反応炉が何かのガスを噴き出して、部下たちは完全に正気を失ってしまってな。

key: They're as you see now-- lost and confused.
en: They're as you see now-- lost and confused.
ja: 見ての通りだ――みんな、混乱して我を失っている。

key: What can we do against this?
en: What can we do against this?
ja: これに対して、我々に何ができる?

key: If you intend to do something, then this may be of use.
en: If you intend to do something, then this may be of use.
ja: 何かするつもりなら、これが役に立つかもしれん。

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 11!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 11!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解析データ11を手に入れた!

key: Info on Corrosive Mist Field now available!
en: Info on Corrosive Mist Field now available!
ja: 腐食霧フィールドの情報が閲覧可能になった!

key: CHIEF: We have reason to believe that in addition to mind-altering substances, the reactors in this building are capable of creating this environment.
en: CHIEF: We have reason to believe that in addition to mind-altering substances, the reactors in this building are capable of creating this environment.
ja: 署長: この建物の反応炉は、精神を狂わせる物質に加えて、この環境を作り出す能力があると考える理由がある。

key: Please tread carefully.
en: Please tread carefully.
ja: どうか、慎重に進んでくれ。

key: CHIEF: You defeated Corey?
en: CHIEF: You defeated Corey?
ja: 署長: コーリーを倒したのか?

key: That's great, but now we have to catch him.
en: That's great, but now we have to catch him.
ja: それは良かった、だが今度は奴を捕まえなければ。

key: You go ahead. The police unit will follow behind as able.
en: You go ahead. The police unit will follow behind as able.
ja: 先に行ってくれ。警察隊は可能な限り後から続く。

key: Obey...
en: Obey...
ja: したがえ……

key: Aagh! ...Huh?
en: Aagh! ...Huh?
ja: あぎゃっ! ……え?

key: What happened? We came in to arrest Corey, but then... I don't remember.
en: What happened? We came in to arrest Corey, but then... I don't remember.
ja: 何があったんだ? コーリーを逮捕しに来たはずなのに……覚えていない。

key: Attack...
en: Attack...
ja: 攻撃……

key: Urgh... What happened?
en: Urgh... What happened?
ja: うぐ……何があったんだ?

key: All I remember is a hissing noise... Gas, maybe?
en: All I remember is a hissing noise... Gas, maybe?
ja: 覚えているのはシューッという音だけだ……ガスか?

key: We are to serve...
en: We are to serve...
ja: 我らは仕えるべし……

key: WOAH, what's going on?!
en: WOAH, what's going on?!
ja: うおっ、何が起きてるんだ?!

key: Huh? These vials spit out some kind of poison! What did it do to us?
en: Huh? These vials spit out some kind of poison! What did it do to us?
ja: あれ? この小瓶、何か毒みたいなものを噴き出してるぞ! 一体何をされたんだ?

key: Open Gym door?
en: Open Gym door?
ja: ジムの扉を開けますか?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
